As the lead general of the legions under the Queen's command, 
her belligerence knows no bounds, nor does her appetite for destruction.

lines.text: There's nothing I despise more than boredom.
Keep pestering me, and see what happens.
So boooooring! If you don't get a move on, you'll be sorry.
If you bug me, I'll return it two-fold.
Don't be scared. I don't feel like meddling in your affairs right now.
I'm jonesing for a fix right now, and I gotta break something. Wanna join me?
Don't just stand there and stare at me. Move.
Okay, soak it all in while you can. This is the only chance you're going to get.
Hm... This place ain't so bad. Plenty of things to break.
Everything here reeks of your scent, Human. I'm itching to tear it all to shreds.
I can't believe you brought me to such a peaceful place... You all right?
You've got your work cut out for you, Human. I'm gonna destroy everything.
Ugh, I wanna go bust something up.
You're not too bad yourself.
Good job, Human.
Trying to ply me with gifts, are you? Well, do keep trying.
The best present would be having you on a silver platter... but I should probably stop now.
You really do know what I like.
Hmm... You're kind of fun.
Humans are usually such monotonous creatures. Yet, you're not the same.
I'd love to swallow you up just once... I guess now's not the time?
You think you can handle me?
What?
Is that place a little more exciting?
Are things finally going to pick up?
I can use a little excitement right now.
You can run, but you can't hide!
Haha! Time to play.
Let's keep it going.
Now it's starting to get fun!
More, more, more! Let's fight!
Let's go wild!
It's my turn! Taste this!
Kill them all! Mwahahaha!
Next!
C'mon, next! Hurry up!
Gotcha.
Hm?
Oh yeah?
Haha!
This is boring. I'm done here.
Well, that was fun, wasn't it?
